name: Moonpig Group PLC
research_rationale: H1 FY27 buyback completed (£32.5m) with no trading update before 8 Dec results; unchanged FCF basis, leverage and liquidity flags still support the screen hold.

weekly_updates.summary:
29 Oct RNS: FY27 half-year results on 8 Dec 2026; FY26 final dividend (2.50p) euro conversion confirmed for payment on 19 Nov.
Since the 8 Oct memo: routine buyback and holdings notices only; no trading update or new earnings.
News batch is mostly off-topic; screen remains hold (5w, stable) with FCF and liquidity flags unchanged.

2 Nov RNS: H1 FY27 share buyback programme completed (£32.5m cancelled); group may conduct up to £65m buybacks in FY27.  
Since 30 Oct: routine transaction-in-own-shares notices through 20 Nov only; half-year results still due 8 Dec—no new trading data.  
Screen remains hold (11w, stable); FCF basis mismatch and weak liquidity unchanged.
